brand_story.summary: The published family story describes parents wanting more transparency about dessert ingredients. Experimentation followed, an ice cream machine arrived in June 2024, and visits from friends and their children helped shape the Ice Cream Factory idea.
brand_story.mission_summary: Make desserts with straightforward ingredients and earn families’ trust.
brand_story.conversation_hook: A family-inspired place for curious dessert lovers, with a factory visit and tasting listed on the website.

timeline.event: Arrival of an ice cream machine, according to the brand story.
